column3: To Refute And Persuade
Just as I thought...
Huh?
Senpai actually sides with this girl.
...Siscon?
How did it turn out like this? All right, Kuroneko, listen to me.
Her expression is as cold as ever, but it seems that she's angry.
I kinda want to cheer her up...
Your skills are essential to obtain victory.
Hmph... Why didn't you say that from the start?
Why are you acting all high and mighty?
Kirino, please keep quiet for now. Don't complicate things further.
Hah?
Kiririn-shi, it's fine. Let's see what Kyousuke-shi has to say.
Eh? ...Well, I guess there's no choice. I'll keep quiet for now.
Kuroneko. What I'm trying to say is...
Trying to persuade me with uninspired words is pointless.
Getting so sulky...
What I want to say is...
What should I say?
They are both very stubborn, so it will only get worse if I say something weird.
...Hmph.
Anyway, please calm down!
Listen, what is your objective? Try considering it once more!
...Objective?
Our objective is...
To achieve victory!
Right?
So now isn't the time to be quarreling!
If you have something to say, then speak quickly.
I just said something, but it didn't quite reach her ears.
I-I only have to shut up and wait for the storm to pass...
Hmm... As I thought, we have no need for this wicked girl's power.
What a coincidence. For I also decline joining forces with you.
That's bad. If I wait, it'll certainly collapse
Wh-What should I do? I know! Isn't this when I get rescued by Saori?!
A good friendship is a beautiful thing, isn't it, Kyousuke-shi?
As usual, there is something wrong with your eyesight...
It can't be helped; I'll have to do something.
